items.question: Trong câu "Before you build your own linked lists, trees and heaps, it is worth analysing the structures JavaScript gives you out of the box.", từ "analyse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Before you build your own linked lists, trees and heaps, it is worth analysing the structures JavaScript gives you out of the box.", what does "analyse" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: analyse /ˈæn.əl.aɪz/ (động từ): phân tích. "It is worth analysing X" = đáng để phân tích X; cách viết Mỹ là "analyze".
items.explanationEn: analyse /ˈæn.əl.aɪz/ (verb): to examine in detail. "It is worth analysing X" means X deserves a close look; the American spelling is "analyze".

items.question: Trong câu "Before you build your own linked lists, trees and heaps, it is worth analysing the structures JavaScript gives you out of the box.", từ "out of the box" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Before you build your own linked lists, trees and heaps, it is worth analysing the structures JavaScript gives you out of the box.", what does "out of the box" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: out of the box /ˌaʊt əv ðə ˈbɒks/ (cụm từ): có sẵn, dùng ngay được. Dùng cho tính năng có sẵn không cần cài thêm; khác với "think outside the box" (nghĩ sáng tạo).
items.explanationEn: out of the box /ˌaʊt əv ðə ˈbɒks/ (phrase): ready to use as provided. Used for features that work without extra setup; different from "think outside the box" (be creative).

items.question: Trong câu "You use them in almost every line of code, and most "why is this slow?" bugs come from not knowing what a built-in operation really costs.", từ "built-in" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You use them in almost every line of code, and most "why is this slow?" bugs come from not knowing what a built-in operation really costs.", what does "built-in" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: built-in /ˌbɪltˈɪn/ (tính từ): có sẵn, tích hợp sẵn. "A built-in method/function" = hàm có sẵn của ngôn ngữ, ví dụ Array.prototype.map.
items.explanationEn: built-in /ˌbɪltˈɪn/ (adjective): included as a standard part. "A built-in method/function" is one the language provides, such as Array.prototype.map.

items.question: Trong câu "This topic covers the Big O of objects and arrays, why adding to the front of an array is expensive, the cost of common built-in methods, when to reach for Map and Set, and why building a string in a loop is a hidden trap.", từ "reach for" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This topic covers the Big O of objects and arrays, why adding to the front of an array is expensive, the cost of common built-in methods, when to reach for Map and Set, and why building a string in a loop is a hidden trap.", what does "reach for" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to choose to use a tool
items.explanation: reach for /ˈriːtʃ fɔːr/ (cụm từ): chọn dùng (công cụ). "Reach for Map" = tìm đến / chọn dùng Map khi cần; nghĩa đen là "với tay lấy".
items.explanationEn: reach for /ˈriːtʃ fɔːr/ (phrase): to choose to use a tool. "Reach for Map" means pick Map as your tool; literally it means stretching your hand to grab something.

items.question: Trong câu "This topic covers the Big O of objects and arrays, why adding to the front of an array is expensive, the cost of common built-in methods, when to reach for Map and Set, and why building a string in a loop is a hidden trap.", từ "trap" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This topic covers the Big O of objects and arrays, why adding to the front of an array is expensive, the cost of common built-in methods, when to reach for Map and Set, and why building a string in a loop is a hidden trap.", what does "trap" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a safe place to rely on
items.explanation: trap /træp/ (danh từ): cái bẫy, lỗi dễ mắc. "A hidden trap" = cái bẫy ẩn; cụm hay gặp: "fall into the trap of..." (mắc bẫy...).
items.explanationEn: trap /træp/ (noun): a hidden danger or mistake. "A hidden trap" is a danger that is easy to miss; common phrase: "fall into the trap of...".

items.question: Trong câu "Quick reminder from the previous topic: we care about how the work grows with n, we drop constants, and we count hidden loops inside library calls.", từ "drop" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Quick reminder from the previous topic: we care about how the work grows with n, we drop constants, and we count hidden loops inside library calls.", what does "drop" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: drop /drɒp/ (động từ): bỏ đi, lược bỏ. Trong Big O, "drop constants" = bỏ các hằng số; "drop" còn nghĩa "làm rơi" hoặc "giảm".
items.explanationEn: drop /drɒp/ (verb): to leave out, omit. In Big O, "drop constants" means ignore constant factors; "drop" can also mean "let fall" or "decrease".

items.question: Trong câu "Conceptually it is a hash table: the engine turns the key into a location, so it never has to scan every entry.", từ "conceptually" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Conceptually it is a hash table: the engine turns the key into a location, so it never has to scan every entry.", what does "conceptually" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: conceptually /kənˈsep.tʃu.ə.li/ (trạng từ): về mặt khái niệm. Dùng khi mô tả ý tưởng chung, không nhất thiết là cách cài đặt thực tế bên dưới.
items.explanationEn: conceptually /kənˈsep.tʃu.ə.li/ (adverb): in terms of the idea. Used to describe the general idea, not necessarily the real implementation underneath.

items.question: Trong câu "Conceptually it is a hash table: the engine turns the key into a location, so it never has to scan every entry.", từ "scan" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Conceptually it is a hash table: the engine turns the key into a location, so it never has to scan every entry.", what does "scan" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to go through item by item
items.explanation: scan /skæn/ (động từ): duyệt qua lần lượt. "Scan every entry" = duyệt từng mục; "a linear scan" = duyệt tuần tự O(n).
items.explanationEn: scan /skæn/ (verb): to go through item by item. "Scan every entry" means check each item in turn; "a linear scan" is an O(n) pass.

items.question: Trong câu "The O(1) figures are average costs of a hash lookup; the worst case is discussed in section 12.", từ "figure" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The O(1) figures are average costs of a hash lookup; the worst case is discussed in section 12.", what does "figure" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: figure /ˈfɪɡ.ər/ (danh từ): con số. "The O(1) figures" = các con số O(1); "figure" cũng có nghĩa "hình vẽ" (Figure 1).
items.explanationEn: figure /ˈfɪɡ.ər/ (noun): a number or amount. "The O(1) figures" are the numbers quoted; "figure" can also mean a diagram (Figure 1).

items.question: Trong câu ""Unordered" is not quite literal (integer-like keys iterate first, in ascending order), but do not rely on key order — if order matters, use an array or a Map.", từ "literal" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence ""Unordered" is not quite literal (integer-like keys iterate first, in ascending order), but do not rely on key order — if order matters, use an array or a Map.", what does "literal" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: literal /ˈlɪt.ər.əl/ (tính từ): theo nghĩa đen. "Not quite literal" = không hoàn toàn đúng theo nghĩa đen; trong code, "literal" còn là giá trị viết trực tiếp.
items.explanationEn: literal /ˈlɪt.ər.əl/ (adjective): exactly as the words say. "Not quite literal" means not exactly true word for word; in code a "literal" is a value written directly.

items.question: Trong câu ""Unordered" is not quite literal (integer-like keys iterate first, in ascending order), but do not rely on key order — if order matters, use an array or a Map.", từ "ascending" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence ""Unordered" is not quite literal (integer-like keys iterate first, in ascending order), but do not rely on key order — if order matters, use an array or a Map.", what does "ascending" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: ascending /əˈsen.dɪŋ/ (tính từ): tăng dần. "In ascending order" = theo thứ tự tăng dần; trái nghĩa: "descending" (giảm dần).
items.explanationEn: ascending /əˈsen.dɪŋ/ (adjective): going from small to large. "In ascending order" means smallest first; the opposite is "descending".

items.question: Trong câu ""Unordered" is not quite literal (integer-like keys iterate first, in ascending order), but do not rely on key order — if order matters, use an array or a Map.", từ "rely on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence ""Unordered" is not quite literal (integer-like keys iterate first, in ascending order), but do not rely on key order — if order matters, use an array or a Map.", what does "rely on" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: rely on /rɪˈlaɪ ɒn/ (cụm từ): dựa vào, trông cậy vào. "Do not rely on key order" = đừng dựa vào thứ tự key; danh từ: "reliance", tính từ: "reliable".
items.explanationEn: rely on /rɪˈlaɪ ɒn/ (phrase): to depend on. "Do not rely on key order" means do not depend on it; related: "reliable", "reliance".

items.question: Trong câu "Use an object when you do not need order and you want fast lookup, insertion and removal by a known key: a user record, a config, a lookup table from id to data.", từ "record" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Use an object when you do not need order and you want fast lookup, insertion and removal by a known key: a user record, a config, a lookup table from id to data.", what does "record" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a set of data about one item
items.explanation: record /ˈrek.ɔːd/ (danh từ): bản ghi (dữ liệu). "A user record" = bản ghi thông tin một người dùng; động từ "record" /rɪˈkɔːd/ = ghi lại.
items.explanationEn: record /ˈrek.ɔːd/ (noun): a set of data about one item. "A user record" is the data about one user; the verb "record" /rɪˈkɔːd/ means to write down.

items.question: Trong câu "Also beware of Object.keys(obj).length inside a loop — it rebuilds a whole array just to count the keys, turning an O(n) loop into O(n²).", từ "beware" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Also beware of Object.keys(obj).length inside a loop — it rebuilds a whole array just to count the keys, turning an O(n) loop into O(n²).", what does "beware" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: beware /bɪˈweər/ (động từ): cẩn thận, đề phòng. "Beware of X" = hãy cẩn thận với X; thường dùng ở dạng mệnh lệnh.
items.explanationEn: beware /bɪˈweər/ (verb): to be careful about. "Beware of X" means watch out for X; usually used as a command.

items.question: Trong câu "You can picture it as a row of numbered slots", từ "slot" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You can picture it as a row of numbered slots", what does "slot" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a narrow opening for a card
a position that holds a value
items.explanation: slot /slɒt/ (danh từ): ô, vị trí chứa. "Numbered slots" = các ô được đánh số; "time slot" = khung giờ.
items.explanationEn: slot /slɒt/ (noun): a position that holds a value. "Numbered slots" are positions with numbers; a "time slot" is a period in a schedule.

items.question: Trong câu "Access by index is O(1) because the engine can compute where slot i lives.", từ "compute" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Access by index is O(1) because the engine can compute where slot i lives.", what does "compute" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: compute /kəmˈpjuːt/ (động từ): tính toán ra. "Compute where slot i lives" = tính ra vị trí ô i; danh từ: "computation".
items.explanationEn: compute /kəmˈpjuːt/ (verb): to work out by calculation. "Compute where slot i lives" means calculate its address; noun: "computation".

items.question: Trong câu "A common misconception is that arr[9999] is slower than arr[0] — it is not.", từ "misconception" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A common misconception is that arr[9999] is slower than arr[0] — it is not.", what does "misconception" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: misconception /ˌmɪs.kənˈsep.ʃən/ (danh từ): quan niệm sai lầm. "A common misconception is that..." = một hiểu lầm phổ biến là...
items.explanationEn: misconception /ˌmɪs.kənˈsep.ʃən/ (noun): a wrong belief. "A common misconception is that..." introduces a widely held but wrong belief.

items.question: Trong câu "Every element knows its index, so any change that moves elements forces the array to renumber them.", từ "renumber" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every element knows its index, so any change that moves elements forces the array to renumber them.", what does "renumber" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to give a new name to
items.explanation: renumber /ˌriːˈnʌm.bər/ (động từ): đánh số lại. Tiền tố "re-" = làm lại: renumber, re-index, rebuild.
items.explanationEn: renumber /ˌriːˈnʌm.bər/ (verb): to give new numbers to. The prefix "re-" means again: renumber, re-index, rebuild.

items.question: Trong câu "Adding or removing at the front shifts every element by one", từ "shift" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Adding or removing at the front shifts every element by one", what does "shift" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: shift /ʃɪft/ (động từ): dịch chuyển (vị trí). "Shifts every element by one" = dịch mọi phần tử đi một vị trí; danh từ "shift" còn là "ca làm".
items.explanationEn: shift /ʃɪft/ (verb): to move to another position. "Shifts every element by one" moves each item one place; as a noun "shift" is also a work period.

items.question: Trong câu "push is amortized O(1): occasionally the engine must allocate a bigger backing store and copy everything (O(n)), but that happens rarely enough that the average cost per push stays constant.", từ "amortized" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "push is amortized O(1): occasionally the engine must allocate a bigger backing store and copy everything (O(n)), but that happens rarely enough that the average cost per push stays constant.", what does "amortized" (adjective) mean?
options: được chia đều (chi phí trung bình)
tệ nhất có thể xảy ra
được đo chính xác từng lần
items.explanation: amortized /ˈæm.ə.taɪzd/ (tính từ): được chia đều (chi phí trung bình). "Amortized O(1)" = trung bình O(1) khi tính trên nhiều thao tác, dù thỉnh thoảng một lần tốn O(n); gốc từ tài chính "khấu hao".
items.explanationEn: amortized /ˈæm.ə.taɪzd/ (adjective): averaged over many operations. "Amortized O(1)" means O(1) on average over many operations even if one is O(n); the word comes from finance.

items.question: Trong câu "push is amortized O(1): occasionally the engine must allocate a bigger backing store and copy everything (O(n)), but that happens rarely enough that the average cost per push stays constant.", từ "occasionally" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "push is amortized O(1): occasionally the engine must allocate a bigger backing store and copy everything (O(n)), but that happens rarely enough that the average cost per push stays constant.", what does "occasionally" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: occasionally /əˈkeɪ.ʒən.əl.i/ (trạng từ): thỉnh thoảng. Mức tần suất: always > usually > sometimes > occasionally > rarely > never.
items.explanationEn: occasionally /əˈkeɪ.ʒən.əl.i/ (adverb): now and then. Frequency scale: always > usually > sometimes > occasionally > rarely > never.

items.question: Trong câu "push is amortized O(1): occasionally the engine must allocate a bigger backing store and copy everything (O(n)), but that happens rarely enough that the average cost per push stays constant.", từ "allocate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "push is amortized O(1): occasionally the engine must allocate a bigger backing store and copy everything (O(n)), but that happens rarely enough that the average cost per push stays constant.", what does "allocate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: allocate /ˈæl.ə.keɪt/ (động từ): cấp phát (bộ nhớ). "Allocate memory" = cấp phát bộ nhớ; ngược lại: "free / deallocate".
items.explanationEn: allocate /ˈæl.ə.keɪt/ (verb): to set aside for use. "Allocate memory" means reserve it; the opposite is "free" or "deallocate".

items.question: Trong câu "push is amortized O(1): occasionally the engine must allocate a bigger backing store and copy everything (O(n)), but that happens rarely enough that the average cost per push stays constant.", từ "constant" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "push is amortized O(1): occasionally the engine must allocate a bigger backing store and copy everything (O(n)), but that happens rarely enough that the average cost per push stays constant.", what does "constant" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: constant /ˈkɒn.stənt/ (tính từ): không đổi. "Stays constant" = giữ không đổi; "constant time" = O(1); "constant complaints" = than phiền liên miên.
items.explanationEn: constant /ˈkɒn.stənt/ (adjective): staying the same. "Stays constant" means it does not change; "constant time" is O(1); "constant complaints" means non-stop ones.

items.question: Trong câu "So push + pop make an efficient stack, but push + shift is a slow queue for large inputs", từ "efficient" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "So push + pop make an efficient stack, but push + shift is a slow queue for large inputs", what does "efficient" (adjective) mean?
options: hiệu quả, ít tốn tài nguyên
optionsEn: doing a job with little waste
items.explanation: efficient /ɪˈfɪʃ.ənt/ (tính từ): hiệu quả, ít tốn tài nguyên. "Efficient" nhấn vào ít lãng phí; "effective" nhấn vào đạt kết quả. Danh từ: "efficiency".
items.explanationEn: efficient /ɪˈfɪʃ.ənt/ (adjective): doing a job with little waste. "Efficient" stresses low waste; "effective" stresses getting the result. Noun: "efficiency".

items.question: Trong câu "Engines sometimes optimise shift on small arrays, but you should assume O(n).", từ "assume" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Engines sometimes optimise shift on small arrays, but you should assume O(n).", what does "assume" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to take as true without proof
items.explanation: assume /əˈsjuːm/ (động từ): giả định, mặc định là. "You should assume O(n)" = nên mặc định là O(n); "assume a role" = đảm nhận vai trò. Danh từ: "assumption".
items.explanationEn: assume /əˈsjuːm/ (verb): to take as true without proof. "You should assume O(n)" means treat it as O(n); "assume a role" means take one on. Noun: "assumption".

items.question: Trong câu "Cost: O(n) in general (precisely, proportional to the elements after the index plus the items inserted or removed).", từ "proportional" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Cost: O(n) in general (precisely, proportional to the elements after the index plus the items inserted or removed).", what does "proportional" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: proportional /prəˈpɔː.ʃən.əl/ (tính từ): tỷ lệ thuận (với). "Proportional to n" = tỷ lệ với n, tức n tăng gấp đôi thì chi phí cũng tăng gấp đôi.
items.explanationEn: proportional /prəˈpɔː.ʃən.əl/ (adjective): growing in step with. "Proportional to n" means the cost doubles when n doubles.

items.question: Trong câu "Inserting near the end is cheap; inserting near the front is as bad as unshift.", từ "cheap" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Inserting near the end is cheap; inserting near the front is as bad as unshift.", what does "cheap" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: cheap /tʃiːp/ (tính từ): tốn ít chi phí (tài nguyên). Trong lập trình "cheap operation" = thao tác tốn ít thời gian/bộ nhớ; ngược lại "expensive".
items.explanationEn: cheap /tʃiːp/ (adjective): costing little work. In programming a "cheap operation" uses little time or memory; the opposite is "expensive".

items.question: Trong câu "Trick when order does not matter: to delete index i in O(1), overwrite it with the last element and pop.", từ "overwrite" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Trick when order does not matter: to delete index i in O(1), overwrite it with the last element and pop.", what does "overwrite" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to replace old data with new
items.explanation: overwrite /ˌəʊ.vəˈraɪt/ (động từ): ghi đè lên. "Overwrite it with the last element" = ghi đè giá trị bằng phần tử cuối; dữ liệu cũ bị mất.
items.explanationEn: overwrite /ˌəʊ.vəˈraɪt/ (verb): to replace old data with new. "Overwrite it with the last element" replaces the old value, which is lost.

items.question: Trong câu "Two traps hide in this table", từ "hide" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Two traps hide in this table", what does "hide" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: hide /haɪd/ (động từ): ẩn nấp, nằm khuất. "Two traps hide in this table" = có hai cái bẫy nằm khuất trong bảng; tính từ "hidden".
items.explanationEn: hide /haɪd/ (verb): to be out of sight. "Two traps hide in this table" means they are not obvious; adjective: "hidden".

items.question: Trong câu "The callback counts.", từ "count" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The callback counts.", what does "count" (verb) mean?
options: có ảnh hưởng, được tính vào
items.explanation: count /kaʊnt/ (động từ): có ảnh hưởng, được tính vào. "The callback counts" = chi phí callback cũng phải tính; "count on" = trông cậy.
items.explanationEn: count /kaʊnt/ (verb): to matter, to be included. "The callback counts" means its cost must be included; "count on" means depend on.

items.question: Trong câu "Chaining multiplies memory, not time.", từ "multiply" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Chaining multiplies memory, not time.", what does "multiply" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: multiply /ˈmʌl.tɪ.plaɪ/ (động từ): nhân lên, tăng nhiều lần. "Chaining multiplies memory" = nối chuỗi làm bộ nhớ tăng gấp nhiều lần; danh từ: "multiplication".
items.explanationEn: multiply /ˈmʌl.tɪ.plaɪ/ (verb): to increase many times. "Chaining multiplies memory" means memory use grows several times; noun: "multiplication".

items.question: Trong câu "arr.filter(f).map(g).reduce(h) is three O(n) passes — O(3n) = O(n) time — but creates two intermediate arrays.", từ "intermediate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "arr.filter(f).map(g).reduce(h) is three O(n) passes — O(3n) = O(n) time — but creates two intermediate arrays.", what does "intermediate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: intermediate /ˌɪn.təˈmiː.di.ət/ (tính từ): trung gian. "Intermediate arrays" = mảng trung gian tạo ra giữa các bước; "intermediate level" = trình độ trung cấp.
items.explanationEn: intermediate /ˌɪn.təˈmiː.di.ət/ (adjective): in between two stages. "Intermediate arrays" are created between steps; "intermediate level" means mid-level skill.

items.question: Trong câu "arr.filter(f).map(g).reduce(h) is three O(n) passes — O(3n) = O(n) time — but creates two intermediate arrays.", từ "pass" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "arr.filter(f).map(g).reduce(h) is three O(n) passes — O(3n) = O(n) time — but creates two intermediate arrays.", what does "pass" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: pass /pɑːs/ (danh từ): một lượt duyệt. "Three O(n) passes" = ba lượt duyệt qua mảng; "single-pass" = chỉ duyệt một lần.
items.explanationEn: pass /pɑːs/ (noun): one run through the data. "Three O(n) passes" means going over the data three times; "single-pass" means once.

items.question: Trong câu "Arrays are O(n) there; use a proper queue", từ "proper" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanation: proper /ˈprɒp.ər/ (tính từ): đúng nghĩa, phù hợp. "A proper queue" = một hàng đợi đúng nghĩa; "proper behaviour" = cư xử đứng đắn.
items.explanationEn: proper /ˈprɒp.ər/ (adjective): real and suitable. "A proper queue" is a real, fit-for-purpose queue; "proper behaviour" means polite conduct.

items.question: Trong câu "Objects do not model order", từ "model" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?

optionsEn: to work as a fashion model
items.explanation: model /ˈmɒd.əl/ (động từ): biểu diễn, mô phỏng. "Objects do not model order" = object không biểu diễn khái niệm thứ tự; "data model" = mô hình dữ liệu.
items.explanationEn: model /ˈmɒd.əl/ (verb): to represent in a system. "Objects do not model order" means order is not part of what they represent; see "data model".

items.question: Trong câu "A very common optimisation is to turn an array into a lookup table once, then answer many queries in O(1)", từ "optimisation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A very common optimisation is to turn an array into a lookup table once, then answer many queries in O(1)", what does "optimisation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: optimisation /ˌɒp.tɪ.maɪˈzeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự tối ưu hoá. "A common optimisation" = một cách tối ưu hay dùng; cách viết Mỹ: "optimization".
items.explanationEn: optimisation /ˌɒp.tɪ.maɪˈzeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): making something faster. "A common optimisation" is a usual way to speed code up; American spelling: "optimization".

items.question: Trong câu "A very common optimisation is to turn an array into a lookup table once, then answer many queries in O(1)", từ "query" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A very common optimisation is to turn an array into a lookup table once, then answer many queries in O(1)", what does "query" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: query /ˈkwɪə.ri/ (danh từ): truy vấn (tra dữ liệu). "Answer many queries in O(1)" = trả lời mỗi lần tra cứu trong O(1); "a customer query" = câu hỏi của khách.
items.explanationEn: query /ˈkwɪə.ri/ (noun): a request for data. "Answer many queries in O(1)" means each lookup is O(1); "a customer query" is a question from a customer.

items.question: Trong câu "You trade O(n) extra memory for a big time win — the time/space trade-off in action.", từ "trade" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You trade O(n) extra memory for a big time win — the time/space trade-off in action.", what does "trade" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to give up one thing for another
items.explanation: trade /treɪd/ (động từ): đánh đổi. "Trade X for Y" = bỏ ra X để đổi lấy Y; ở đây đổi bộ nhớ lấy tốc độ.
items.explanationEn: trade /treɪd/ (verb): to give up one thing for another. "Trade X for Y" means give up X to get Y; here memory is given up for speed.

items.question: Trong câu "You trade O(n) extra memory for a big time win — the time/space trade-off in action.", từ "trade-off" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You trade O(n) extra memory for a big time win — the time/space trade-off in action.", what does "trade-off" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: trade-off /ˈtreɪd.ɒf/ (danh từ): sự đánh đổi. "The time/space trade-off" = đánh đổi giữa thời gian và bộ nhớ, cụm cực hay gặp khi phỏng vấn.
items.explanationEn: trade-off /ˈtreɪd.ɒf/ (noun): a balance between two gains. "The time/space trade-off" is the balance between speed and memory, a key interview phrase.

items.question: Trong câu "You trade O(n) extra memory for a big time win — the time/space trade-off in action.", từ "in action" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanation: in action /ɪn ˈæk.ʃən/ (cụm từ): khi áp dụng thực tế. "X in action" = X được vận dụng cụ thể, ví dụ minh hoạ thực tế.
items.explanationEn: in action /ɪn ˈæk.ʃən/ (phrase): being used for real. "X in action" means a concrete example of X being applied.

items.question: Trong câu "Map (ES2015) is a dedicated key-value collection.", từ "dedicated" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Map (ES2015) is a dedicated key-value collection.", what does "dedicated" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: dedicated /ˈded.ɪ.keɪ.tɪd/ (tính từ): chuyên dụng, dành riêng. "A dedicated collection" = cấu trúc dành riêng cho việc đó; "a dedicated teacher" = giáo viên tận tâm.
items.explanationEn: dedicated /ˈded.ɪ.keɪ.tɪd/ (adjective): made for one purpose. "A dedicated collection" is built for one job; "a dedicated teacher" is a committed one.

items.question: Trong câu "Its operations have the same average costs as an object, but it fixes several object quirks", từ "quirk" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: quirk /kwɜːk/ (noun): an odd behaviour. "Object quirks" are strange behaviours of objects; adjective: "quirky".

items.question: Trong câu "Rule of thumb: use a plain object for fixed-shape records and JSON; use a Map for a dynamic dictionary whose keys are added and removed at run time.", từ "rule of thumb" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanation: rule of thumb /ˌruːl əv ˈθʌm/ (cụm từ): quy tắc kinh nghiệm. "Rule of thumb" = nguyên tắc dựa trên kinh nghiệm, đúng trong đa số trường hợp.
items.explanationEn: rule of thumb /ˌruːl əv ˈθʌm/ (phrase): a practical guideline. "Rule of thumb" is a rough guide from experience that is right most of the time.

items.question: Trong câu "Rule of thumb: use a plain object for fixed-shape records and JSON; use a Map for a dynamic dictionary whose keys are added and removed at run time.", từ "plain" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rule of thumb: use a plain object for fixed-shape records and JSON; use a Map for a dynamic dictionary whose keys are added and removed at run time.", what does "plain" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: plain /pleɪn/ (tính từ): thông thường, không thêm gì. "A plain object" = object thường {}; "plain text" = văn bản thuần; "in plain English" = nói dễ hiểu.
items.explanationEn: plain /pleɪn/ (adjective): ordinary, with nothing extra. "A plain object" is an ordinary {}; "plain text" has no formatting; "in plain English" means clearly.

items.question: Trong câu "Rule of thumb: use a plain object for fixed-shape records and JSON; use a Map for a dynamic dictionary whose keys are added and removed at run time.", từ "dynamic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rule of thumb: use a plain object for fixed-shape records and JSON; use a Map for a dynamic dictionary whose keys are added and removed at run time.", what does "dynamic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: dynamic /daɪˈnæm.ɪk/ (tính từ): thay đổi được khi chạy. "A dynamic dictionary" = từ điển có key thêm/bớt liên tục; trái nghĩa "static".
items.explanationEn: dynamic /daɪˈnæm.ɪk/ (adjective): changing while running. "A dynamic dictionary" has keys added and removed over time; opposite: "static".

items.question: Trong câu "Rule of thumb: use a plain object for fixed-shape records and JSON; use a Map for a dynamic dictionary whose keys are added and removed at run time.", từ "at run time" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rule of thumb: use a plain object for fixed-shape records and JSON; use a Map for a dynamic dictionary whose keys are added and removed at run time.", what does "at run time" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: at run time /ət ˈrʌn taɪm/ (cụm từ): trong lúc chương trình chạy. Đối lập với "at compile time" (lúc biên dịch).
items.explanationEn: at run time /ət ˈrʌn taɪm/ (phrase): while the program executes. Contrasts with "at compile time".

items.question: Trong câu "A Set stores each value at most once, with O(1) average add, has and delete", từ "at most" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A Set stores each value at most once, with O(1) average add, has and delete", what does "at most" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: at most /ət ˈməʊst/ (cụm từ): nhiều nhất, tối đa. "At most once" = tối đa một lần; ngược lại "at least" = ít nhất.
items.explanationEn: at most /ət ˈməʊst/ (phrase): no more than. "At most once" means once or never; the opposite is "at least".

items.question: Trong câu "Set operations by hand, with a and b the two set sizes", từ "by hand" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Set operations by hand, with a and b the two set sizes", what does "by hand" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: by hand /baɪ ˈhænd/ (cụm từ): tự làm thủ công. "Set operations by hand" = tự viết phép toán tập hợp thay vì dùng hàm có sẵn.
items.explanationEn: by hand /baɪ ˈhænd/ (phrase): done manually yourself. "Set operations by hand" means writing them yourself instead of using built-ins.

items.question: Trong câu "Modern runtimes (for example Node 22+) also provide a.union(b), a.intersection(b) and a.difference(b) directly.", từ "provide" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: provide /prəˈvaɪd/ (verb): to make available. "Also provide a.union(b)" means they make it available; noun: "provider".

items.question: Trong câu "Equality pitfalls: a Set compares with SameValueZero — NaN equals NaN, but objects and arrays are compared by reference", từ "pitfall" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?

optionsEn: a deep hole in the ground

items.explanationEn: pitfall /ˈpɪt.fɔːl/ (noun): a likely mistake. "Equality pitfalls" are easy mistakes when comparing values; common phrase: "common pitfalls".

items.question: Trong câu "Equality pitfalls: a Set compares with SameValueZero — NaN equals NaN, but objects and arrays are compared by reference", từ "by reference" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Equality pitfalls: a Set compares with SameValueZero — NaN equals NaN, but objects and arrays are compared by reference", what does "by reference" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: by reference /baɪ ˈref.ər.əns/ (cụm từ): theo tham chiếu (địa chỉ). "Compared by reference" = so sánh xem có cùng một object không; đối lập "by value".
items.explanationEn: by reference /baɪ ˈref.ər.əns/ (phrase): by identity of the object. "Compared by reference" checks whether it is the same object; opposite: "by value".

items.question: Trong câu "Equality pitfalls: a Set compares with SameValueZero — NaN equals NaN, but objects and arrays are compared by reference", từ "equality" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Equality pitfalls: a Set compares with SameValueZero — NaN equals NaN, but objects and arrays are compared by reference", what does "equality" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: equality /iˈkwɒl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): sự bằng nhau (khi so sánh). Trong code, "equality" là phép so sánh bằng (===); trong xã hội là "bình đẳng".
items.explanationEn: equality /iˈkwɒl.ə.ti/ (noun): being equal when compared. In code "equality" is the === check; in society it means equal rights.

items.question: Trong câu "Compared with an array, a Set gives O(1) instead of O(n) membership tests and removal by value, but it has no access by position and no duplicates.", từ "membership" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: membership /ˈmem.bə.ʃɪp/ (noun): being part of a set. "Membership test" checks whether a value is in a collection, e.g. set.has(x).

items.question: Trong câu "Compared with an array, a Set gives O(1) instead of O(n) membership tests and removal by value, but it has no access by position and no duplicates.", từ "duplicate" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Compared with an array, a Set gives O(1) instead of O(n) membership tests and removal by value, but it has no access by position and no duplicates.", what does "duplicate" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: duplicate /ˈdjuː.plɪ.kət/ (danh từ): bản trùng lặp. "No duplicates" = không có phần tử trùng; động từ "duplicate" /ˈdjuː.plɪ.keɪt/ = nhân bản.
items.explanationEn: duplicate /ˈdjuː.plɪ.kət/ (noun): a repeated copy. "No duplicates" means no repeated values; the verb /ˈdjuː.plɪ.keɪt/ means to copy.

items.question: Trong câu "JavaScript strings behave like read-only arrays of characters (UTF-16 code units).", từ "behave" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: behave /bɪˈheɪv/ (verb): to act or work. "Behave like X" means act the way X does; noun: "behaviour".

items.question: Trong câu "You can read s[i] and s.length in O(1), but you can never change a string in place", từ "in place" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanation: in place /ɪn ˈpleɪs/ (cụm từ): tại chỗ, không tạo bản sao. "Change in place" = sửa trực tiếp trên dữ liệu gốc; "in place of" lại có nghĩa "thay cho".
items.explanationEn: in place /ɪn ˈpleɪs/ (phrase): without making a copy. "Change in place" means modify the original directly; "in place of" means "instead of".

items.question: Trong câu "Every "modification" creates a new string, so almost every string method is O(n)", từ "modification" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every "modification" creates a new string, so almost every string method is O(n)", what does "modification" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: modification /ˌmɒd.ɪ.fɪˈkeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự sửa đổi. "Every modification creates a new string" = mỗi lần sửa tạo chuỗi mới; động từ: "modify".
items.explanationEn: modification /ˌmɒd.ɪ.fɪˈkeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): a change made. "Every modification creates a new string" means each change makes a new one; verb: "modify".

items.question: Trong câu "On paper each step copies everything built so far", từ "on paper" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "On paper each step copies everything built so far", what does "on paper" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: on paper /ɒn ˈpeɪ.pər/ (cụm từ): trên lý thuyết. "On paper" = về lý thuyết (có thể khác thực tế), hay đi cặp với "in practice".
items.explanationEn: on paper /ɒn ˈpeɪ.pər/ (phrase): in theory. "On paper" means in theory, often contrasted with "in practice".

items.question: Trong câu "Engines like V8 optimise += with rope structures, so it is often fast in practice — but in interviews, and in languages such as Java or Python, the collect-then-join pattern is the one guaranteed to be O(n).", từ "in practice" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Engines like V8 optimise += with rope structures, so it is often fast in practice — but in interviews, and in languages such as Java or Python, the collect-then-join pattern is the one guaranteed to be O(n).", what does "in practice" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in practice /ɪn ˈpræk.tɪs/ (cụm từ): trong thực tế. "Fast in practice" = thực tế chạy nhanh, dù lý thuyết có thể chậm.
items.explanationEn: in practice /ɪn ˈpræk.tɪs/ (phrase): in real use. "Fast in practice" means quick in real use, even if theory says otherwise.

items.question: Trong câu "Engines like V8 optimise += with rope structures, so it is often fast in practice — but in interviews, and in languages such as Java or Python, the collect-then-join pattern is the one guaranteed to be O(n).", từ "guarantee" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Engines like V8 optimise += with rope structures, so it is often fast in practice — but in interviews, and in languages such as Java or Python, the collect-then-join pattern is the one guaranteed to be O(n).", what does "guarantee" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: guarantee /ˌɡær.ənˈtiː/ (động từ): đảm bảo chắc chắn. "Guaranteed to be O(n)" = chắc chắn là O(n) trong mọi trường hợp; danh từ cũng là "guarantee" (bảo hành).
items.explanationEn: guarantee /ˌɡær.ənˈtiː/ (verb): to promise for certain. "Guaranteed to be O(n)" means always O(n); as a noun it also means a warranty.

items.question: Trong câu "If many keys collide in the same bucket, a lookup degrades towards O(n) in the worst case (hash tables get their own topic later).", từ "collide" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If many keys collide in the same bucket, a lookup degrades towards O(n) in the worst case (hash tables get their own topic later).", what does "collide" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to land in the same spot
items.explanation: collide /kəˈlaɪd/ (động từ): trùng nhau (cùng vị trí). Trong bảng băm, key "collide" khi rơi vào cùng một bucket; danh từ: "collision" (xung đột băm).
items.explanationEn: collide /kəˈlaɪd/ (verb): to land in the same spot. In a hash table keys collide when they land in the same bucket; noun: "collision".

items.question: Trong câu "If many keys collide in the same bucket, a lookup degrades towards O(n) in the worst case (hash tables get their own topic later).", từ "bucket" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If many keys collide in the same bucket, a lookup degrades towards O(n) in the worst case (hash tables get their own topic later).", what does "bucket" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a slot group in a hash table
items.explanation: bucket /ˈbʌk.ɪt/ (danh từ): ô chứa (trong bảng băm). "The same bucket" = cùng một ô trong bảng băm; nghĩa thường là "cái xô"; "bucket list" = danh sách điều muốn làm.
items.explanationEn: bucket /ˈbʌk.ɪt/ (noun): a slot group in a hash table. "The same bucket" is one slot group of a hash table; everyday meaning is a pail; "bucket list" is a wish list.

items.question: Trong câu "If many keys collide in the same bucket, a lookup degrades towards O(n) in the worst case (hash tables get their own topic later).", từ "degrade" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If many keys collide in the same bucket, a lookup degrades towards O(n) in the worst case (hash tables get their own topic later).", what does "degrade" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: degrade /dɪˈɡreɪd/ (động từ): kém đi, suy giảm. "Degrades towards O(n)" = hiệu năng tụt dần về O(n); danh từ: "degradation".
items.explanationEn: degrade /dɪˈɡreɪd/ (verb): to get worse. "Degrades towards O(n)" means performance falls toward O(n); noun: "degradation".

items.question: Trong câu "In everyday code with a good engine, treat them as O(1) but say "average" in interviews.", từ "treat" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In everyday code with a good engine, treat them as O(1) but say "average" in interviews.", what does "treat" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: treat /triːt/ (động từ): coi như, xem như. "Treat them as O(1)" = coi chúng là O(1); "treat someone to dinner" = mời ai ăn tối.
items.explanationEn: treat /triːt/ (verb): to regard as. "Treat them as O(1)" means regard them as O(1); "treat someone to dinner" means pay for it.

items.question: Trong câu "Sparse arrays. const a = []; a[1_000_000] = 1; gives a.length === 1000001 with holes; iterating it is not "one element".", từ "sparse" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sparse arrays. const a = []; a[1_000_000] = 1; gives a.length === 1000001 with holes; iterating it is not "one element".", what does "sparse" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: sparse /spɑːs/ (tính từ): thưa thớt, có lỗ trống. "Sparse arrays" = mảng thưa, có nhiều vị trí trống; trái nghĩa "dense".
items.explanationEn: sparse /spɑːs/ (adjective): having many empty gaps. "Sparse arrays" have many empty positions; the opposite is "dense".

items.question: Trong câu "Sparse arrays. const a = []; a[1_000_000] = 1; gives a.length === 1000001 with holes; iterating it is not "one element".", từ "iterate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sparse arrays. const a = []; a[1_000_000] = 1; gives a.length === 1000001 with holes; iterating it is not "one element".", what does "iterate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: iterate /ˈɪt.ər.eɪt/ (động từ): duyệt lặp qua. "Iterating it" = duyệt qua từng phần tử; danh từ "iteration" = một vòng lặp; nghĩa cũ là "nhắc lại".
items.explanationEn: iterate /ˈɪt.ər.eɪt/ (verb): to loop through. "Iterating it" means looping over its items; "iteration" is one loop pass; older sense: to repeat.

items.question: Trong câu "delete arr[i] leaves a hole (undefined slot) and does not shrink the array or re-index — use splice or the swap-and-pop trick.", từ "shrink" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "delete arr[i] leaves a hole (undefined slot) and does not shrink the array or re-index — use splice or the swap-and-pop trick.", what does "shrink" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: shrink /ʃrɪŋk/ (động từ): thu nhỏ lại. "Does not shrink the array" = không làm mảng ngắn đi; trái nghĩa "grow".
items.explanationEn: shrink /ʃrɪŋk/ (verb): to become smaller. "Does not shrink the array" means its length stays the same; opposite: "grow".

items.question: Trong câu "delete on objects in hot code can push the engine into a slower dictionary representation; a Map is built for frequent deletes.", từ "representation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "delete on objects in hot code can push the engine into a slower dictionary representation; a Map is built for frequent deletes.", what does "representation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: representation /ˌrep.rɪ.zenˈteɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): cách biểu diễn (dữ liệu). "Dictionary representation" = cách engine lưu object dưới dạng từ điển; "represent" = biểu diễn / đại diện.
items.explanationEn: representation /ˌrep.rɪ.zenˈteɪ.ʃən/ (noun): a way of storing data. "Dictionary representation" is how the engine stores the object internally; verb: "represent".

items.question: Trong câu "delete on objects in hot code can push the engine into a slower dictionary representation; a Map is built for frequent deletes.", từ "frequent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "delete on objects in hot code can push the engine into a slower dictionary representation; a Map is built for frequent deletes.", what does "frequent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: frequent /ˈfriː.kwənt/ (tính từ): thường xuyên. "Frequent deletes" = xoá thường xuyên; danh từ: "frequency" (tần suất).
items.explanationEn: frequent /ˈfriː.kwənt/ (adjective): happening often. "Frequent deletes" means deleting often; noun: "frequency".

items.question: Trong câu "Strings are immutable: each edit is a new O(n) string; build with an array and join.", từ "immutable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Strings are immutable: each edit is a new O(n) string; build with an array and join.", what does "immutable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: immutable /ɪˈmjuː.tə.bəl/ (tính từ): bất biến, không sửa được. "Strings are immutable" = chuỗi không thể sửa tại chỗ; trái nghĩa "mutable".
items.explanationEn: immutable /ɪˈmjuː.tə.bəl/ (adjective): unable to be changed. "Strings are immutable" means they cannot be edited in place; opposite: "mutable".

items.question: Trong câu "Prefer Map for dynamic dictionaries or non-string keys, Set for membership and dedupe.", từ "prefer" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Prefer Map for dynamic dictionaries or non-string keys, Set for membership and dedupe.", what does "prefer" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: prefer /prɪˈfɜːr/ (động từ): ưu tiên chọn. "Prefer Map for X" = nên ưu tiên Map cho X; cấu trúc "prefer A to B".
items.explanationEn: prefer /prɪˈfɜːr/ (verb): to choose rather than others. "Prefer Map for X" means choose Map first for X; pattern: "prefer A to B".

items.question: Trong câu "JavaScript gives you objects, arrays, Map, Set and strings; knowing their costs prevents accidental O(n²) code.", từ "accidental" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "JavaScript gives you objects, arrays, Map, Set and strings; knowing their costs prevents accidental O(n²) code.", what does "accidental" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: accidental /ˌæk.sɪˈden.təl/ (tính từ): vô tình, ngoài ý muốn. "Accidental O(n²) code" = code O(n²) viết ra mà không hề hay biết; trạng từ "accidentally".
items.explanationEn: accidental /ˌæk.sɪˈden.təl/ (adjective): happening by mistake. "Accidental O(n²) code" is slow code written without noticing; adverb: "accidentally".

items.question: Trong câu "Strings cannot be changed in place, so repeated concatenation copies; collect parts and join once.", từ "concatenation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Strings cannot be changed in place, so repeated concatenation copies; collect parts and join once.", what does "concatenation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: concatenation /kənˌkæt.əˈneɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự nối chuỗi. "Repeated concatenation" = nối chuỗi nhiều lần liên tiếp; động từ: "concatenate".
items.explanationEn: concatenation /kənˌkæt.əˈneɪ.ʃən/ (noun): joining strings together. "Repeated concatenation" means joining strings again and again; verb: "concatenate".

items.question: Trong câu "Map is the dictionary of choice for dynamic keys; Set turns O(n) membership tests into O(1).", từ "of choice" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Map is the dictionary of choice for dynamic keys; Set turns O(n) membership tests into O(1).", what does "of choice" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: of choice /əv ˈtʃɔɪs/ (cụm từ): được ưa chuộng nhất. "The dictionary of choice" = lựa chọn hàng đầu khi cần từ điển; mẫu "the X of choice".
items.explanationEn: of choice /əv ˈtʃɔɪs/ (phrase): preferred above others. "The dictionary of choice" is the preferred one; pattern: "the X of choice".
